resources.string: Lets your phones find, pair with and ring each other over Bluetooth.
Forget a phone after it goes quiet for
Signal strength over the last minute
Open Pvot Finder on both phones. Show a code on one of them and scan it with the other. Both phones need Bluetooth on.
Only pair phones you own. A paired phone can find this one whenever it is nearby.
On your other phone, open Pvot Finder, then Add a phone, then Scan a code.
Point the camera at the code shown on your other phone.
Pvot Finder needs the camera to scan the pairing code. It is used only on this screen.
Check that the other phone shows the same code.
Waiting for the other phone to confirm
Pairing needs the Nearby devices permission, so the phones can talk over Bluetooth.
That is not a Pvot Finder pairing code.
The code has expired. Show a new one on the other phone.
Could not reach the other phone over Bluetooth. Keep the phones close and try again.
The phones could not agree. Scan the code again.
A different phone answered than the one that showed the code. Nothing was shared.
Pairing was cancelled on the other phone. Nothing was shared.
The other phone sent something unexpected. Update Pvot Finder on both phones.
Shown to phones you pair with
This phone stops being able to find it
To find each other again you will have to pair again. If that phone was lost or stolen, whoever has it can still find your other phones: reset Pvot Finder on them.
Forget all paired phones and make new keys
This phone forgets every paired phone and gets new keys. Your other phones can no longer find it until you pair again.
Pvot Finder is ringing this phone
Not heard right now. Keep Pvot Finder open and walk around; the other phone needs \"Your phones can find this one\" turned on.
Heard its identifier. Check that it is really your phone before relying on it.
It proved it is your phone. Signal strength is a rough sign of closeness, not a distance.
Could not connect. Move closer and try again.
The phone answering could not prove it is yours.
That phone refused. It may not be allowed to show notifications.
Needed so this phone can ring when your other phones look for it. It only rings with a notification you can stop.
Your phones can find this one
Pvot Finder is advertising over Bluetooth so your paired phones can find it.
Lets this phone remember where it was when it last heard your other phones. Kept on this phone only.
This phone remembers where it was each time it hears %1$s, while Pvot Finder is open.
%1$s, place unknown: Pvot Finder had no location permission
Off. When on, your paired phones can see where this phone is from anywhere, as long as it has internet.
Turn on \"Let my phones find this one\" too.
Choose at least one notice board.
Every 30 minutes, locked so only your paired phones can read it.

Reports are left on public notice boards (Nostr relays) for your other phones to pick up. Boards are run by other people. They see this phone\'s internet address and when it posts, but cannot read the locations or tell whose phone it is. Add the addresses of boards you trust.
Use an address starting with wss://
Where %1$s said it was, from the notice boards.
Add a notice board on the home screen to see online reports.
%1$s has not reported in the last 7 days.
Place accurate to about %1$d m, battery %2$d%%
Advertises over Bluetooth so your paired phones can find, check and ring this one, also when the app is closed. A notification shows while it is on.
Your phones find each other over Bluetooth. Turn it on to see them here.
This phone has no Bluetooth Low Energy, so Pvot Finder cannot find other phones from it.
Your phones can find this one
Off. Your other phones cannot find or ring this one.
On, also when Pvot Finder is closed
Bluetooth refused to advertise. Open Settings, then Diagnostics.
Pair your other phones once. Then they find, check and ring each other over Bluetooth, with no account and no server.

Pvot Finder uses this phone's location for two things.

Last seen: when this phone hears one of your paired phones, it remembers where it was. This stays on this phone.

Online reports, only if you turn them on: every 30 minutes, also when the app is closed, this phone sends its location to the notice boards you chose, locked so that only your paired phones can read it.

Pvot Finder does not use location for anything else and never sends it to PVOT.
